authorization: Owner separately requested numeric analysis of available results and posting it on PR230 after the blind terminal merge. This review is numeric, unlike the earlier outcome-blind terminal review.
scope: Descriptive partial analysis only; no scoring, training, official report command, retry, PR write or cleanup by reviewer.

provenance.selection: Exactly frozen sorted jobs[:9], including five retained and four new complete roots; timing pilots and interrupted tenth root excluded.

independent_recomputation.method: Read raw metric arrays directly; group each metric by the two target solver seats; average gain_bb with math.fsum/2, then equal-weight roots. Normalize only frozen fold-specific matched iterations. Recompute all distributions independently of parent helper using exact randrange draw sequence.
independent_recomputation.bootstrap: Exploratory paired nine-root resampling, 2000 draws, Random(202610050002), indices49/1949; not the frozen 40-root qualification.
independent_recomputation.Q: Ratio of means in each paired draw, not mean of per-root ratios.

report_and_comment_review.limits: Nine-root exploratory unadjusted intervals cover empirical root variation, not missing-root or training-seed uncertainty; two seats are averaged, not resampled independently. No pass/fail/inconclusive classification or full-game qualification, no favorable replacement-checkpoint recommendation.
report_and_comment_review.witness: E=0.3917 clearly labeled full40-corpus/three-lineage context, not matched nine-root witness; subtraction descriptive only.
report_and_comment_review.plot: Visually inspected six-panel E/Q chart; units, values, references, bands, title and caveat agree. Fold-specific matched iterations plotted at documented midpoint.

unblinding.historical_report_crosslink: Only an explanatory paragraph is added to the prior continuation report, identifying the separate later authorized inspection; historical stop narrative and archived evidence stay intact.

archival_scope: Derived outputs, helpers and retrieval provenance only. Keep 29 extracted raw inputs local. Accepted raw score/reference/model/table payloads must not be duplicated in new derived bundle. Parent archival acceptance recorded separately.
